name: Medicare Coverage: Sleep Testing for OSA
sourceName: Synthetic stand-in for a Medicare National Coverage Determination (modeled on NCD 240.4.1 style). Not real CMS text.
serviceLabel: Sleep testing for suspected obstructive sleep apnea (in-lab or home)

coverage.gapReason: Covers sleep testing for beneficiaries with OSA signs and symptoms, but does not specify when an attended in-lab study is needed instead of a home test.

versions.approvalRule: Coverage gate only. Plan criteria supplement the setting decision.
versions.note: Medicare criteria come first for Medicare Advantage. Where they are not fully established, plans may use publicly posted, evidence-based internal or commercial criteria.

criteria.title: Signs and symptoms of OSA documented
criteria.description: The beneficiary has clinical signs and symptoms indicative of obstructive sleep apnea.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Provider documentation of OSA signs or symptoms.

criteria.title: Face-to-face clinical evaluation
criteria.description: The test is ordered by the treating provider after a face-to-face clinical evaluation.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Encounter note from the ordering provider.

changeLog.author: Policy sync (CMS coverage feed)
changeLog.summary: Imported from the CMS coverage database.
